title: Mutant Testing for Reward Model Misspecification

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Mutation testing for reward models could systematize misspecification auditing. Clear chain: identify blind spots in reward models before they cause misalignment. Novel cross-domain transfer with practical utility.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires access to and ability to modify open-source reward model internals, then measure downstream policy behavior changes. This involves both reward model engineering and RL training evaluation — substantial technical depth for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Designing mutations, applying them, training downstream policies for each, and measuring behavioral changes is a large experimental matrix. Each mutation requires its own evaluation pipeline. Exceeds 30 hours for beginners.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
